# T2G-Former attribution

Mechanism adapted from jyansir/t2g-former, commit 3ad093d7967b726b265606251ec267daa0756427, bin/t2g_former.py, MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 LionSenSei.

https://github.com/jyansir/t2g-former/tree/3ad093d7967b726b265606251ec267daa0756427

This CPU adaptation adds fixed self/readout edges, all-layer pre-normalization and the repository's frozen partition training. It is not exact reproduction of all upstream experiments. No external weights or datasets are used.
